Aspect Ratio - Width: the width of the final image


Aspect Ratio - Height: the height of the final image


Size to be Close to SDXL: This node automatically changes the size of the image to fit the SDXL standard size closest to the custom size


Current Size: This node shows the size currently used by the workflow


Reference Image: Upload the image that will be used by IPAdapter to drive the Model


Apply PhotoMaker Style: Is used to quickly change styles without having to edit the prompt


Custom Positive Prompt: This box is for inserting a Custom Prompt, so it excludes the JoyTag node, and IPAdapter as well.


Using the IPAdapter: This node is used to force the use of IPAdapter, even when using a Custom Prompt


Toggle FaceDetailer: Activates or deactivates the Face Detailer


Toggle Attention Mask: Activates or deactivates the Attention Mask for IPAdapter. Used on images with people or animals.


Final Prompt Text: This is only used to control the prompt that will be processed.
